page.overview:
Who is Alexander Luthor, Jr.?

When the Anti-Monitor at last came to Prime Earth and killed Darkseid, several members of the Justice League became gods in the aftermath. S. custody, which they did along with a new Power Ring and the newly Grid-possessed Cyborg.

Though initially hostile to them, Superwoman stopped her attack when Owlman returned, telling her that in order to succeed, the Crime Syndicate and the Justice League would have to work together.

During the fight against Steve Trevor—who had been forced to absorb the power of the Anti-Life Equation—and Grail, Superwoman gave birth to Alexander Luthor,Jr.

She then used him to drain the powers of both Superman and Luthor while commenting her son was the inheritor of evil and that like his father before him, the child is able to absorb any energy, even that of the Gods with Superwoman also believing her son will be the most powerful being on Earth in this universe or any universe. With her eyes glowing red, Superwoman vowed that they would destroy all who stood in their way but Grail then used her Omega Beams to incinerate Superwoman, killing her with Grail commenting that Superwoman had loved to hear herself talk. When her mother expressed concern for the baby, Grail told her she wouldn't hurt it and after everything the cow (Superwoman) went on and on about, she would use it the way her mother had used her. She then took the child, which possessed the same ability as Mazahs and this ability was used to absorb the Omega effect from Lex Luthor as well as the Anti-Life Equation from Steve Trevor, causing the child to die and serve as a host for Darkseid.

entity.description:
When the Anti-Monitor at last came to Prime Earth and killed Darkseid, several members of the Justice League became gods in the aftermath. The Justice League were left with little choice but to free Ultraman and Superwoman from A.R.G.U.S. custody, which they did along with a new Power Ring and the newly Grid-possessed Cyborg. Though initially hostile to them, Superwoman stopped her attack when Owlman returned, telling her that in order to succeed, the Crime Syndicate and the Justice League would have to work together.

During the fight against Steve Trevor—who had been forced to absorb the power of the Anti-Life Equation—and Grail, Superwoman gave birth to Alexander Luthor,Jr. She then used him to drain the powers of both Superman and Luthor while commenting her son was the inheritor of evil and that like his father before him, the child is able to absorb any energy, even that of the Gods with Superwoman also believing her son will be the most powerful being on Earth in this universe or any universe. With her eyes glowing red, Superwoman vowed that they would destroy all who stood in their way but Grail then used her Omega Beams to incinerate Superwoman, killing her with Grail commenting that Superwoman had loved to hear herself talk. When her mother expressed concern for the baby, Grail told her she wouldn't hurt it and after everything the cow (Superwoman) went on and on about, she would use it the way her mother had used her. She then took the child, which possessed the same ability as Mazahs and this ability was used to absorb the Omega effect from Lex Luthor as well as the Anti-Life Equation from Steve Trevor, causing the child to die and serve as a host for Darkseid.
